name: flow
description: Opinionated multi-step development workflow: kickoff -> research -> plan -> develop -> deploy -> code-review-brief -> review-triage -> cleanup. Atomic commits, TDD-first, brief-based review.

interface.shortDescription: Multi-step development workflow with planning, TDD, deploy, and review.
interface.longDescription: Council Flow provides an opinionated development workflow: kickoff, research, plan, develop, deploy, code-review-brief, review-triage, and cleanup. It emphasizes isolated worktrees, atomic conventional commits, TDD where practical, Korean user-facing summaries, parallel subagent tiers, and a brief-based review the user runs their own agents against.
